fields.label: Organization name
fields.description: Private canonical organization name withheld from workspace inspection and bound to selected local review.

fields.label: Organization description
fields.description: Private factual prose used only with governed classification rules and the current provider option set.

fields.label: Website or domain
fields.description: Optional private website URL or bare domain normalized to one HTTPS resource identity.

fields.label: Twitter handle or URL
fields.description: Optional private handle or Twitter URL normalized to one HTTPS profile identity.

fields.label: Known aliases
fields.description: Optional private exact name variants searched with bounded policy-derived variants before create.

fields.label: Requested organization type
fields.description: Optional private exact Type request; it is accepted only when present in the current normalized schema observation.

fields.label: Requested organization tags
fields.description: Optional private tag requests; every value must match a current normalized schema option.
